record.title: Masters Degree in Continuing Education in Marketing in London 2027
record.longDescription: The Master’s Degree in Continuing Education in Marketing equips professionals with advanced knowledge of modern marketing practices and strategic management. The program integrates core business disciplines with contemporary marketing tools and digital performance strategies. Learners develop analytical, leadership, and decision-making skills to compete in dynamic global markets. The curriculum bridges theory and practical application for real-world business challenges.
record.courseDetails:
This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of marketing within the broader business environment. Students explore socioeconomic and legal frameworks influencing business decisions. Core modules in accounting, finance, human resource management, and strategy build strong managerial foundations. Specialized modules focus on marketing communication, search and social performance marketing, and affiliate and email strategies. The program emphasizes strategic thinking, measurable marketing outcomes, and sustainable competitive advantage. It is designed for professionals seeking career advancement in marketing and leadership roles.The programme offers 10 modules of 7 ECTS each and one thesis of 20 ECTS.

Upon successful completion of the programme, students will be able to:

Analyze the socioeconomic and legal factors influencing marketing decisions.

Interpret financial and accounting data to support marketing strategies.

Develop comprehensive marketing plans aligned with business objectives.

Apply strategic management principles to gain competitive advantage.

Design integrated marketing communication strategies.

Evaluate and implement performance marketing campaigns in search and social platforms.

Utilize affiliate and email marketing strategies to drive measurable results.

Demonstrate leadership and human resource management skills in marketing teams.

Assess contemporary marketing challenges and emerging trends.

Formulate data-driven strategic marketing decisions.
outcomes: Analyze the socioeconomic and legal factors influencing marketing decisions.
Interpret financial and accounting data to support marketing strategies.
Develop comprehensive marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
Apply strategic management principles to gain competitive advantage.
Evaluate and implement performance marketing campaigns in search and social platforms.
Utilize affiliate and email marketing strategies to drive measurable results.
Demonstrate leadership and human resource management skills in marketing teams.
Assess contemporary marketing challenges and emerging trends.

Masters Degree in Continuing Education in Marketing

The Master’s Degree in Continuing Education in Marketing equips professionals with advanced knowledge of modern marketing practices and strategic management. The program integrates core business disciplines with contemporary marketing tools and digital performance strategies. Learners develop analytical, leadership, and decision-making skills to compete in dynamic global markets. The curriculum bridges theory and practical application for real-world business challenges.
Course Details

This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of marketing within the broader business environment. Students explore socioeconomic and legal frameworks influencing business decisions. Core modules in accounting, finance, human resource management, and strategy build strong managerial foundations. Specialized modules focus on marketing communication, search and social performance marketing, and affiliate and email strategies. The program emphasizes strategic thinking, measurable marketing outcomes, and sustainable competitive advantage. It is designed for professionals seeking career advancement in marketing and leadership roles.The programme offers 10 modules of 7 ECTS each and one thesis of 20 ECTS.
Upon successful completion of the programme, students will be able to:
Analyze the socioeconomic and legal factors influencing marketing decisions.
Interpret financial and accounting data to support marketing strategies.
Develop comprehensive marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
Apply strategic management principles to gain competitive advantage.
Design integrated marketing communication strategies.
Evaluate and implement performance marketing campaigns in search and social platforms.
Utilize affiliate and email marketing strategies to drive measurable results.
Demonstrate leadership and human resource management skills in marketing teams.
Assess contemporary marketing challenges and emerging trends.
Formulate data-driven strategic marketing decisions.

Masters Degree in Continuing Education in Marketing
The Master’s Degree in Continuing Education in Marketing equips professionals with advanced knowledge of modern marketing practices and strategic management. The program integrates core business disciplines with contemporary marketing tools and digital performance strategies. Learners develop analytical, leadership, and decision-making skills to compete in dynamic global markets. The curriculum bridges theory and practical application for real-world business challenges.

evidence.heading: courseDetails
evidence.text:
Course Details
This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of marketing within the broader business environment. Students explore socioeconomic and legal frameworks influencing business decisions. Core modules in accounting, finance, human resource management, and strategy build strong managerial foundations. Specialized modules focus on marketing communication, search and social performance marketing, and affiliate and email strategies. The program emphasizes strategic thinking, measurable marketing outcomes, and sustainable competitive advantage. It is designed for professionals seeking career advancement in marketing and leadership roles.The programme offers 10 modules of 7 ECTS each and one thesis of 20 ECTS.
Upon successful completion of the programme, students will be able to:
Analyze the socioeconomic and legal factors influencing marketing decisions.
Interpret financial and accounting data to support marketing strategies.
Develop comprehensive marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
Apply strategic management principles to gain competitive advantage.
Design integrated marketing communication strategies.
Evaluate and implement performance marketing campaigns in search and social platforms.
Utilize affiliate and email marketing strategies to drive measurable results.
Demonstrate leadership and human resource management skills in marketing teams.
Assess contemporary marketing challenges and emerging trends.
Formulate data-driven strategic marketing decisions.

By the end, learners will be able to analyze performance metrics and improve ROI across search and social channels.

get started
Create a free account
Register to join our online learning platform by filling out our inquiry form.
Upload your document
Make available all necessary academic credentials on your student portal.
Receive conditional offer letter
The admissions panel will next evaluate your application. When you meet the requirements, a letter of offer confirming your enrollment in the program will be made public.
Make payment for tuition
The tuition must be paid within the allotted time frame. Greetings on your enrollment!
Attend lectures & live webinar classes
Attend lectures on your student portal and join our live webinar classes.
Assignment & Assessment
Login into your student portal to take your quiz and assignment..
Get your diploma/degree
Receive your globally recognized and WES evaluated certificate.

This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of marketing within the broader business environment. Students explore socioeconomic and legal frameworks influencing business decisions. Core modules in accounting, finance, human resource management, and strategy build strong managerial foundations. Specialized modules focus on marketing communication, search and social performance marketing, and affiliate and email strategies. The program emphasizes strategic thinking, measurable marketing outcomes, and sustainable competitive advantage. It is designed for professionals seeking career advancement in marketing and leadership roles.The programme offers 10 modules of 7 ECTS each and one thesis of 20 ECTS.
Upon successful completion of the programme, students will be able to:
Analyze the socioeconomic and legal factors influencing marketing decisions.
Interpret financial and accounting data to support marketing strategies.
Develop comprehensive marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
Apply strategic management principles to gain competitive advantage.
Design integrated marketing communication strategies.
Evaluate and implement performance marketing campaigns in search and social platforms.
Utilize affiliate and email marketing strategies to drive measurable results.
Demonstrate leadership and human resource management skills in marketing teams.
Assess contemporary marketing challenges and emerging trends.
Formulate data-driven strategic marketing decisions."},{"contentHash":"5ddd837762cae9b57c6d33bf3c6ae7a74c21f7202fa52d713b7be677388cd660","courseSlug":"masters-continuing-education-marketing","heading":"learningOutcomes","id":"chunk-4719283593c21a2f60ca8b95","items":[{"text":"Analyze the socioeconomic and legal factors influencing marketing decisions.","type":"li"},{"text":"Interpret financial and accounting data to support marketing strategies.","type":"li"},{"text":"Develop comprehensive marketing plans aligned with business objectives.","type":"li"},{"text":"Apply strategic management principles to gain competitive advantage.","type":"li"},{"text":"Design integrated marketing communication strategies.","type":"li"},{"text":"Evaluate and implement performance marketing campaigns in search and social platforms.","type":"li"},{"text":"Utilize affiliate and email marketing strategies to drive measurable results.","type":"li"},{"text":"Demonstrate leadership and human resource management skills in marketing teams.","type":"li"},{"text":"Assess contemporary marketing challenges and emerging trends.","type":"li"},{"text":"Formulate data-driven strategic marketing decisions.","type":"li"}],"kind":"programme","ordinal":0,"scope":"global","sectionId":"learningOutcomes","selector":"[id="course-details"] > ol:nth-child(4)","snapshotId":"snapshot-5b0e534e85bb87382440bdec16a129d60458ba5fbea0ed7349e72152065c3e97","text":"Analyze the socioeconomic and legal factors influencing marketing decisions.
